scheme_name: Internship Scheme For Students Of Counselling/ Psychology/ Social Work/ Home Science Etc
other_conditions: Applicant must have a Master's Degree in Social Service, Social Work, Sociology, Psychology, Home Science, or a Post Graduate Diploma in Counselling from a recognized university
Applicant must have completed the postgraduate degree within three years prior to applying
Applicant must have obtained at least 50% marks in aggregate in the final year of the postgraduate program
benefits_summary: Interns receive a monthly allowance of ₹15,000 and one paid leave per month.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self-attested if required)
